scene: You step off the paper-lantern balloon into lively Firework Workshop Lane.
picture: Side-scrolling view along a tiled rooftop street. Far left, a brass robot stacks yellow barrels. Left, the moored paper-lantern balloon bobs gently. Centre, you stand in your red bomber jacket and white roller skates. Right, a striped test rocket rests in a launch rack. Far right, a workshop doorway glows brightly.
shown: a blocky brass spark-proof robot balancing sulfur barrels on the far left
a smoking striped test rocket strapped to a wooden launch rack right
an open bamboo doorway hung with shimmering red dragon tails far right

variants.scene: Your skates clatter onto the rooftop walkway as lantern lights glow all around.
Humming {tune}, you roll past glowing lanterns and bubbling workshop chimneys.
You hop off your paper balloon into the bustling, sulfur-scented rooftop market.
